CustomField.description: This is the formula field which will convert Case Object Complaint Outcome field value(API name) to respective label.
CustomField.formula: CASE(IDR_Complaint_Outcome__c, '1','In favour of customer in full','2', 'In favour of customer in part','3','In favour of ANZ','No response from Customer' ,'No response from Customer' ,'Outside of Rules' ,'Outside of Rules', 'Merits Assessments' ,'Merits Assessments' ,'Merged' ,'Merged' ,'')
CustomField.label: Complaint Outcome Text
